name: Go with friends
summary: Friends interested in an event say Going, Maybe or Can't go; the squad locks when enough are going, then anyone can remind everyone before tickets drop.
useWhen: turning 'interested' into a real headcount for one event
'who's actually going to Khruangbin', 'we need 4 to get the table', 'lock it at 4'
dontUseWhen: buying the tickets once people are in (use ticket-split)
a plan with outsiders asking to join (use open-spots)

params.title: string
params.date: event date line in capitals, e.g. SAT, OCT 4 AT 7 PM
params.tickets: one line about the ticket sale
